source_review.notes: Checked ACM-linked, SIAM, Springer, publisher, DBLP, and author records for external-memory sorting bounds, red-blue pebbling, ideal-cache and cache-oblivious algorithms, buffer trees, cache-oblivious B-trees, and algorithm-engineering treatments. Hardware behavior is presented as a measurement obligation, not an unversioned current fact.

evidence: Checked N, M, B, resident blocks, Scan, Sort, access traces, block identity, working set, and hierarchy-boundary notation.
Checked units, ceilings, cold/warm state, aligned/offset, ideal/actual, lower-bound, and empirical qualifiers.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Transfer counts, physical bytes, latency, bandwidth, CPU work, durability, and elapsed time remain distinct.

evidence: Recomputed aligned and offset scans, LRU traces, block capacity, merge fan-in, concurrent buffers, imbalance analogues, and durable rewrite counts.
Exhaustively bounded LRU miss counts for every length-zero-through-seven trace over eight addresses, and checked the exact 4-miss and 16-miss reference traces.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Hypothetical capacities and policies are declared model inputs.

evidence: Re-derived scan block counts with alignment, multiway merge fan-in/pass structure, and the standard comparison-sorting I/O form.
Re-derived working-set, blocking-reuse, cache-aware/oblivious, and parallel-channel conditions.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Published lower bounds remain attached to their model and parameter regimes.

evidence: Checked empty and partial blocks, misalignment, B=M, working sets around capacity, random/strided traces, variable records, compression, and nested caches.
Checked conflict, prefetch, warm state, concurrent buffers, writeback, durability, shared channels, failures, and counter ambiguity.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: No ideal-cache result is treated as proof of device or end-to-end time.

evidence: Checked common units, declared initial/final state, exact occupied blocks, complete input/output movement, resident reuse, and theorem hypotheses.
The reference preserved LRU recency/capacity and miss-plus-hit equals trace length over exhaustive bounded traces.
invariant_checking.notes: Durability and crash consistency require evidence beyond logical I/O counts.

evidence: Reviewed compulsory scan lower bound and matching sequential access, blocking-fit/reuse proof, merge-run/pass derivation, and lower-bound applicability.
Reviewed empirical mapping from items/blocks to counters without double-counting hierarchy levels.
proof_review.notes: The executable proves one fully associative LRU simulation only.

evidence: Audited theorem, bound, ideal, optimal, cache-aware, cache-oblivious, tall-cache, measured, physical, logical, and durable language.
Separated mathematical transfers, replacement model, operating-system mechanism, device behavior, and production policy.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No classic disk-model claim is projected as universal modern hardware behavior.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet produced exact scan and column-major LRU counts on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
Independent trace enumeration and exercise arithmetic passed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution does not establish real cache, storage, network, writeback, persistence, or performance behavior.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed external-memory and ideal-cache models, scanning, search, sorting, lower bounds, blocking, cache-oblivious recursion, hierarchy composition, writes, persistence, and calibration.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed units, alignment, buffers, concurrency, cache state, prefetch, associativity, compression, queueing, shared topology, writeback, durability, instrumentation, and falsification.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives classic bounds, executes a trace model, exposes model-to-machine limits, supplies ten distinct examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, architecture, operating-system, storage, database, cloud, performance, or operational review is claimed. Conclusions remain conditional on boundary, units, block/capacity parameters, initial state, replacement, representation, concurrency, topology, write and durability policy, instrumentation, toolchain, machine, and workload assumptions.
